questions.title: Look-and-Say Sequence Generation
questions.problem_statement: Implement a function to generate the N-th term of the 'Look-and-Say' sequence. Given term 1 = '1', term 2 = '11', term 3 = '21', term 4 = '1211', term 5 = '111221', compute term N for 1 <= N <= 30 with optimal string handling.
questions.hint: Process the previous string term sequentially, counting contiguous identical digits and appending 'count' + 'digit'.

questions.title: Sub-matrix Sum Queries & 2D Prefix Sum Array
questions.problem_statement: Given an M x N integer matrix and Q query coordinates (r1, c1, r2, c2), compute the sum of all elements within the sub-matrix defined by top-left (r1, c1) and bottom-right (r2, c2). Optimize for O(1) query response time after O(M*N) preprocessing.
questions.hint: Build a 2D Prefix Sum array where prefix[i][j] = matrix[i][j] + prefix[i-1][j] + prefix[i][j-1] - prefix[i-1][j-1].

questions.title: Custom String Tokenizer & Expression Parser without Regex
questions.problem_statement: Write a custom expression evaluator that parses mathematical expressions containing '+', '-', '*', '/', '(', ')' without using built-in evaluation libraries or regular expressions. Respect operator precedence.
questions.hint: Use Shunting-Yard Algorithm with two Stacks: one for values and one for operators.

questions.title: Java Garbage Collection Tuning & Weak Reference Memory Leaks
questions.problem_statement: Explain how Java handles memory leaks when using ThreadLocal variables or static collections. Compare WeakReference, SoftReference, and PhantomReference in custom caching frameworks.
questions.hint: Unremoved ThreadLocal entries persist across thread pool reuse causing memory leaks; SoftReferences are cleared before OOM.

questions.title: SQL Correlated Subquery for N-th Highest Salary per Department
questions.problem_statement: Write an efficient SQL query to find the 3rd highest paid employee in EACH department without using WINDOW functions (DENSE_RANK or ROW_NUMBER).
questions.hint: Use a correlated subquery: SELECT * FROM Employee e1 WHERE 2 = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.salary) FROM Employee e2 WHERE e2.dept_id = e1.dept_id AND e2.salary > e1.salary).

questions.title: DBMS Indexing B-Tree vs Hash Index & Write Amplification
questions.problem_statement: Explain why Hash Indexes cannot support range queries (BETWEEN, <, >) in relational databases. How does B-Tree node splitting impact write latency in high-ingestion workloads?
questions.hint: Hash indexes map keys non-sequentially via hash functions; B-Tree keeps entries sorted maintaining contiguous leaf node pointers.

questions.title: Operating Systems Thread Synchronization Lock-Free Queue
questions.problem_statement: Detail the mechanics of a Lock-Free MPSC (Multi-Producer Single-Consumer) Queue. How do Atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) instructions prevent race conditions without mutex locking overhead?
questions.hint: CAS operations update tail pointers atomically in a loop until successful, eliminating thread blocking and context switches.

questions.title: Computer Networks Custom Binary Protocol Design over Socket
questions.problem_statement: Design a custom application-layer binary protocol over TCP socket for streaming telemetry. Detail packet framing, magic header bytes, payload length encoding, and CRC32 checksum verification.
questions.hint: Structure fixed-size header: [2 bytes Magic] [2 bytes Command ID] [4 bytes Length] [Payload] [4 bytes Checksum].

questions.title: Cryptarithmetic Puzzle Logic
questions.problem_statement: In the cryptarithmetic equation SEND + MORE = MONEY, if each letter represents a distinct digit (0-9) and S != 0, M != 0, what is the single digit value represented by the letter 'O'?
questions.hint: Since S + M produces a carry for 5-digit MONEY, M must be 1. Consequently, S + 1 (+ carry) = 10 + O, yielding O = 0.

questions.title: Clock Angles & Overlapping Hands Calculation
questions.problem_statement: At what exact time between 3 o'clock and 4 o'clock will the minute hand and hour hand of a clock coincide precisely?
questions.hint: At 3:00, initial gap = 15 minute spaces. Relative speed = 55/60 minute spaces per minute. Time = 15 / (55/60) = 180/11 = 16 4/11 mins.

questions.title: Pipes, Reservoirs & Leakage Rate Analysis
questions.problem_statement: A reservoir is normally filled by a inlet pipe in 8 hours. However, due to a leak at the bottom, it takes 2 extra hours to fill the reservoir. How long will the leak take to empty a full reservoir working alone?
questions.hint: Inlet rate = 1/8. Combined rate with leak = 1/10. Leak rate = 1/8 - 1/10 = 1/40 per hour.

questions.title: Combinatorics & Chessboard Rectangles
questions.problem_statement: How many total rectangles (including squares and non-square rectangles) can be formed on a standard 8x8 chessboard?
questions.hint: Choose 2 vertical lines out of 9 (9C2 = 36) and 2 horizontal lines out of 9 (9C2 = 36). Total rectangles = 36 * 36 = 1296.

questions.title: Bayesian Probability & Diagnostic Accuracy
questions.problem_statement: 1 in 1000 server nodes suffers from a silent memory corruption fault. A diagnostic test detects corruption with 99% accuracy when present, but gives a 1% false positive on healthy nodes. If a node tests positive, what is the probability it is actually faulty?

questions.hint: Provide a structured summary: computer science background, key coding accomplishments, project architecture, and career goal.

questions.title: Why Do You Want to Join Zoho?
questions.problem_statement: Why do you want to join Zoho specifically over traditional service companies?
questions.hint: Highlight Zoho's product-first mindset, focus on building software from scratch, deep engineering culture, and long-term vision.

questions.title: Most Challenging Project Worked On
questions.problem_statement: Explain the most challenging software project you've worked on. What made it complex and how did you engineer the solution?
questions.hint: Use STAR format: highlight algorithmic complexity, data structures chosen, trade-offs evaluated, and overall outcome.

questions.title: Difficult Bug Solved & RCA
questions.problem_statement: Describe a subtle, difficult bug you encountered in a codebase and how you diagnosed its root cause.
questions.hint: Explain your step-by-step debugging approach, tools used (profilers, logs, debuggers), and permanent fix implemented.

questions.title: Project Optimization Made
questions.problem_statement: Tell me about a specific performance optimization you made in a project (reducing execution time or memory footprint).
questions.hint: Discuss before vs after metrics, data structure / algorithmic changes, and measurable system improvement.

questions.title: Debugging Philosophy & Approach
questions.problem_statement: How do you approach debugging an unfamiliar codebase when documentation is minimal?
questions.hint: Discuss systematic isolation of modules, trace logging, unit test reproduction, and code inspection.

questions.title: Why Should Zoho Hire You?
questions.problem_statement: Why should Zoho hire you for a core software engineering role?
questions.hint: Demonstrate strong CS fundamentals, passion for writing clean optimized code, self-reliance, and problem-solving depth.
